_sendMessage.description:
Lambda which needs to be set by the server's WebSocketHandler
this lambda will send the message to the Websocket Client

_closeHandler.description: this lambda will close the connection to the Websocket Client

_closed.description: this lambda will be called to check the websocket connection status

title:
Allows types to send and receive messages over a WebSocket connection.
Allows the clients to Send and Receive Messages as a String and clients are allowed to
parse the strings as they wish.
Note: this only allows single session web socket connections and can be used for a single user debugger & other
single session scenarios
name: WebSocketHandler
